title: Lakeview Gulf Retreat | KEY.co
meta_description: Lakefront beauty within walking distance to beach
description_expanded: The second floor boasts a secondary main suite with private porch access, a serene ensuite, and a large walk-in closet, alongside additional bedrooms, each with private ensuites, and a charming bunk room. The third floor's entertainment area and rooftop deck capture breathtaking Gulf views, with an additional bedroom suite completing the upper level. A separate coach house provides a true retreat with a living area, kitchen, and private balcony overlooking the pool and tranquil landscape. With over 2,000 square feet of porch space and proximity to Seaside, The Hub, and pristine beaches, this home blends nature, luxury, and privacy in the heart of the Emerald Coast. Perfectly positioned along 75 feet of serene Tresca Lake frontage, this stunning new construction in Seagrove Beach offers over 5,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space across three luxurious levels. The home's modern coastal architecture is showcased by expansive windows, clean lines, and seamless indoor-outdoor transitions. Upon entry, the main living area opens to a dining room and chef's kitchen, all offering direct access to the outdoor oasis, complete with an oversized pool, hot tub, and private dock. A cozy bedroom suite completes the first level, offering both comfort and convenience.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Two Double Over Double Bunks
